The '''Senate Security Force''', also known as the '''Senate Security Services''', were [[Security guard/Legends|security]] and [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] forces of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] in charge of protecting [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]].<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>

They were stationed at the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Apocalypse" /> though [[Galactic Alliance Security]] held the primary responsibility for protecting the Senate Building.<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref> Members of the Senate Security Force could wear gold armor with either red<ref name="Apocalypse" /> or blue capes.<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>
